finding: Gate-B expert clip was DEFECTIVE (frozen left knee); root-caused, fixed, re-validated; retrain launched.

defect.what: Retargeted Gate-B expert clip data/retarget_gmr/x1_walk_retargeted.npz (sha256 bafcc9d8...) had its LEFT knee_pitch (X1 joint index 3) FROZEN at 0.000 rad for ALL 405 frames, while the RIGHT knee (j9) flexed normally (range 1.41) and the SMPL-X SOURCE flexes BOTH knees (~65 deg each, nearly symmetric).
defect.impact: The defective reference corrupted the AMP imitation target AND the Gate-C jp_err eval metric. The TASK_20260727_024 policy (correctly bending both knees, 0 falls, vx_err 0.15) diverged from the reference's frozen left knee -> jp_err=0.462. The policy was walking BETTER than the reference. The frozen-knee defect is the dominant cause of the jp_err Gate-C failure.
defect.why_gateB_missed_it: validate_retarget_gmr.py checked schema/finite/range/continuity (a frozen joint trivially passes all) but NOT per-joint motion or bilateral gait symmetry.
defect.evidence: scripts/diag_retarget.py (per-joint motion: j3 range 0.000 FROZEN); scripts/diag_source_knee.py (source bilateral flexion L 65.4deg R 63.5deg); scripts/diag_ik_bug.py (variant isolation).

root_cause: retarget_gmr.py solve_leg_ik stage-2 (rotation matching) + per-frame warm-start created a degenerate local minimum pinning the left knee at its lower bound (0.0); the warm-start propagated the trap across all frames. Variant test: stage2+warm FROZEN; stage1-only moves (range 1.04); stage2 fresh-start moves (range 1.24). Only stage2+warm froze it.

fix.change: Multistart IK: additionally seed from the neutral X1 stand pose and keep whichever seed yields the lower POSITION residual. Preserves the GMR rotation-matching stage AND temporal coherence while escaping the trap.
fix.validation_gap_closed: validate_retarget_gmr.py: added 'no frozen actuated joints (each range>0.05)' and 'bilateral knee symmetry (L/R ratio>0.4)' checks.
fix.regenerated_clip: sha256=a115209b1fbdb583f6da8b8d002e0c11789599236c5df17a10fa9913a3d106d7; L_knee range 1.238, R_knee 1.410 (ratio 0.878), all 12 joints active, IK residual L=0.127 R=0.111; validation 22/22 PASS (was 20/20).

retrain_launch.single_variable_change_vs_baseline: DATA ONLY (fixed expert clip). Training config/algorithm/rewards/eval harness UNCHANGED from TASK_20260727_024 baseline (commit 3064f7d). Hypothesis: jp_err drops substantially with a valid bilateral reference while stability/task metrics retained.
retrain_launch.expected: train ~49min + 5-seed eval ~10min; key metric to watch: jp_err (was 0.462, threshold 0.30)

next_round: Poll TASK_20260727_049 to completion; extract data/amp_eval/train_eval_report.json; compare jp_err (hypothesis:大幅下降) + retain fall_rate/vx_err; if jp_err<=0.30 then address dof_viol (safety) + Sim2Sim for full Gate C.
